sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: - Call an LLM API from Python, return JSON validated by a Pydantic model, and handle a bad key, a timeout and an invalid reply without crashing.

sections.heading: Done when
sections.body: The script returns valid JSON for good input and reports each failure clearly.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
- Extend the Lab 1A script to handle three failure modes: timeout, rate limit (429) and invalid JSON from the model
- Write a short note (5 to 8 lines) explaining which failures you retry, which you do not, and why

sections.heading: Details
sections.body:
- Deliverable: Updated script and the short note
- Due: Before Session 2

software-engineering/lab-1b-tested-triag.summary: Turn the Session 1 script into an endpoint with tests

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
- Build a small script or service that calls an LLM API, returns validated structured JSON and handles failures.
- Add a /triage endpoint and three tests: a valid reply, invalid JSON from the model and a timeout.

sections.heading: Done when
sections.body: The endpoint returns valid JSON for good input, never crashes on bad model output and all three tests pass.
